result.rationale: Correct the existing record to the bounded 2025 Project Lotus sale-recapitalization. Direct manager, advisor, trade and legal-entity evidence supports Fengate Infrastructure Fund IV and Montecito Medical Real Estate as current owners at undisclosed stakes through FG MNTO I LOTUS, LLC. The separate Fengate-MedCraft portfolio is excluded from this boundary, and no later portfolio sale, owner exit or signed transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.

evidence.purpose: Direct manager evidence for the acquisition, Fund IV attribution, Montecito partnership and operating scope.
Transaction-advisor evidence for Project Lotus value, financing, portfolio scale and closing.
Trade evidence that Montecito retained an ownership interest after the recapitalization.
Legal-entity evidence for FG MNTO I LOTUS, LLC.
